example_zh: “狗儿生病就像孩子生病一样需要人照顾. ”

example_en: This dependency between fossil and living types is well illustrated when we deal with extinct groups.
example_zh: 化石与现存类型之间的这种依赖关系在我们研究绝灭类群时是十分明显的.

example_en: And they depict an inspanidual photographer's temperament, discovering itself through the camera's cropping of reality.
example_zh: 照片反映个别摄影者的气质, 这种气质是通过照相机剪裁现实而显示出来的.

example_en: The book's strength lay in its depiction of present-day Tokyo.
example_zh: 该书的精彩之处在于其对现今东京的描写。

meaning_zh: vt.耗尽，用尽,使枯竭,[医]减液，放血
example_en: With a small number of requests, the attacker can deplete the application's thread pool.
example_zh: 通过很少数量的请求, 攻击者可以耗尽应用程序的线程池.

example_en: Increased consumption of water has led to rapid depletion of groundwater reserves.
example_zh: 用水量的增加导致了地下水贮备迅速枯竭.

meaning_zh: adj.糟透的，可叹的，可悲的,应受谴责的,破旧的
example_en: The matter in your essay is excellent but the style is deplorable.
example_zh: 你的文章内容不错,但是文体很糟.

meaning_zh: vt.悲悼，哀叹,谴责，强烈反对
example_en: Characteristic you most deplore: Victims. A lot of people get stuck being a victim.
example_zh: 你最痛惜的特点: 诬陷. 不少人被诬陷成为受害者.

meaning_zh: v.部署，调度（军队或武器）,有效地利用；调动
example_en: Deploy and implement internal operation for Japan branch.
example_zh: 负责日本分公司内部日常业务的调配工作.

example_en: Gates responds with a lengthy discourse on deployment strategy.
example_zh: 盖茨以一篇有关部署策略的鸿篇大论予以回应。

example_en: King Ptolemy prohibited Hegesias from lecturing , lest he depopulate the country.
example_zh: 国王托勒密因此禁止何基西亚斯讲课, 以避免其哲学使国家人口下降. )

example_en: The Home Office is usually quick to deport undesirables.
example_zh: 内政部通常会迅速地将不受欢迎人士驱逐出境。

meaning_zh: n.驱逐出境，放逐,递解出境
example_en: Years ago convicted criminals in England could face deportation to Australia.
example_zh: 很多年以前,英国已定罪的犯人可能被驱逐到澳大利亚.

meaning_zh: n.<正>举止，风度，仪态,概,器宇
example_en: Their rabidly nonconformist deportment has made them legendary.
example_zh: 他们坚决的不信奉国教的行为使他们成为传奇.

meaning_zh: vt.罢免，免职,宣誓作证,废黜（君主等）,放置
example_en: A witness must depose to such facts as are within his own knowledge.
example_zh: 证人必须宣誓证明他所知道的事实.

meaning_zh: n.沉积（物）,[律]（在法庭上的）宣誓作证，证词,免职，革职
example_en: Deposition is the laying down of sediment that has been transported.
example_zh: 沉积是已搬运的物质再沉积下来.

example_en: Agricultural soils are the ultimate recipient and depository of most applied foliar and soil pesticides.
example_zh: 喷撒于叶面和用于土壤的农药大多以农业土壤为其最终受体和贮存场所.

meaning_zh: n.仓库,火车站或汽车站,航空站,[军]补给站
example_en: It'seems that not all fat is simply a depot for the accumulation of surplus energy.
example_zh: 并非所有脂肪都是剩余能量的积蓄.

example_en: Three-time Super Bowl champ Brady, at age 30, is the youngest. Jordan and Depp are in their 40s, and the rest—excluding Kennedy, of course—are all over 60 years-old.
example_zh: 三次荣获“超级碗”冠军的布拉迪只有30岁，是其中最年轻的男性；乔丹和戴普40多岁；其余的都是60多岁，当然肯尼迪不算在内。

meaning_zh: n.堕落,腐败,恶行,堕落腐化的行为
example_en: For a truth , she was rather shocked and frightened by this evidence of human depravity.
example_zh: 说实话, 这事足以证明人类的邪恶. 这证据让她大为震惊和害怕.

example_en: I strongly deprecate the use of violence by the students.
example_zh: 我强烈反对学生们使用暴力.

example_en: If you buy a new car, it will rapidly depreciate in value.
example_zh: 如果你买一部新车, 它的价值会迅速的贬值.

meaning_zh: n.（资产等）折旧,货币贬值,跌价
example_en: A depreciation of a currency'svalue makes imports more expensive and exports cheaper.
example_zh: 一国货币的贬值会使其进口更贵，出口更便宜。

meaning_zh: adj.情绪低落的，沮丧的,萧条的,下陷的，低的,中间凹下的
v.压下(depress的过去式和过去分词),使愁苦,降低（价格）,使跌价
example_en: He was really depressed about the business last week, but he's all smiles now. A very big order has just come in.
example_zh: 上个星期他还为生意愁眉苦脸的, 可是现在卻喜形于色, 因为刚接到一笔大订单.

meaning_zh: adj.令人忧愁的，使人沮丧的,使情绪低落的
v.压下( depress的现在分词),使愁苦,降低（价格）,使跌价
example_en: The author gives a depressing picture of life in Poland.
example_zh: 作者描述了一幅令人压抑的波兰生活画面.

meaning_zh: n.[精神分析学]抑郁症患者
example_en: A depressive disorder is a syndrome that reflects a sad mood exceeding normal sadness or grief.
example_zh: 抑郁症是一种综合病症,其反映出的悲伤情绪超出了正常的悲伤和痛苦.

example_en: Changing this could have an enormous impact on deprivation around the world.
example_zh: 改变这个现状将对世界范围内对妇女的剥夺产生巨大的影响.

example_en: He appeared to deprive his city of all its resources, arts, commerce, money, and defenses.
example_zh: 他看似剥夺了他城池的所有资源, 艺术, 商业, 金钱和与国防.

meaning_zh: 剥夺某人的；使失去；使丧失
